classification.difficultyReason: Count horizontal and vertical grid movements between corresponding points.

content.prompt: Describe the translation shown in each of these diagrams.

spec.description: Six-by-six unnumbered square grid with labelled red points. A populated grid requires TikZ rather than the blank-grid template.
spec.mathematics: Relative to the bottom-left grid corner, A=(2,2) and A'=(5,3); these coordinates are not printed.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the supplied points and labels are visible.

answer.worked: From $A$ to $A'$, count 3 grid squares right and 1 grid square up. The translation is 3 units right and 1 unit up.

spec.description: Six-by-six unnumbered square grid with blue original interval, red image interval and red endpoint dots. Labelled intervals require TikZ rather than the blank-grid template.
spec.mathematics: A=(1,3), B=(5,5), A'=(1,1), B'=(5,3) relative to the bottom-left corner; coordinates are not printed.
spec.answerVisibility: Only supplied intervals, endpoint markers and labels are visible.

answer.worked: From $A$ to $A'$, count 2 grid squares down with no horizontal movement. $B$ moves to $B'$ by the same amount. The translation is 2 units down.

spec.description: Six-by-six unnumbered square grid with unfilled blue original triangle and unfilled red image triangle. Labelled polygons require TikZ rather than the blank-grid template.
spec.mathematics: A=(1,3), B=(2,5), C=(3,3), A'=(3,1), B'=(4,3), C'=(5,1) relative to the bottom-left corner; coordinates are not printed.
spec.answerVisibility: Only supplied triangles and vertex labels are visible.

answer.worked: From $A$ to $A'$, count 2 grid squares right and 2 grid squares down. The same movement takes $B$ to $B'$ and $C$ to $C'$. The translation is 2 units right and 2 units down.
